subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this bundle of third-party GitHub Action code upgrades for workflows that receive repository secrets and invoke Codex agents?
rationale: The diff has no identified mechanical defect, but accepting new action implementations at pinned commits is a repository supply-chain and secret-boundary decision that cannot be safely inferred from Dependabot metadata or ordinary CI alone.

options.title: Verify and accept the pinned releases
options.body: Recommended: a workflow/security owner verifies the official upstream releases and exact commit pins, including the Codex action behavior, then merges once the current head’s required checks are green.

options.title: Split high-sensitivity actions
options.body: Ask Dependabot to refresh or split token/Codex-action upgrades from ordinary build and labeling action updates for separate supply-chain review.

options.title: Pause this update
options.body: Leave the PR open until the repository has a reviewed policy or owner capacity for the affected action upgrades.

recommendation.title: Verify and accept the pinned releases
recommendation.body: Recommended: a workflow/security owner verifies the official upstream releases and exact commit pins, including the Codex action behavior, then merges once the current head’s required checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the acceptance decision for CI workflows that execute external action code with secret-bearing credentials.
